name: panel_coverage
what_this_is: avenue C1's feasibility gate — a lookup, recorded
match_rule: exact, on the vendor's symbol column only; no alias mapping is used. A hand-written alias table in the first pass wrongly gave CD20L4 to MS4A12 (it is MS4A7's) and manufactured a PRESENT. permissive_match_would_say records what a whole-sheet search for the exact symbol claims — here, the same thing.

verdict.verdict: C1 NOT RUNNABLE ON A STOCK PANEL
verdict.detail: the target gene is absent from every panel checked, including one at 6,000-plex. C1 needs custom probes for the target itself, which is a different cost and a different lead time from 'order the colon panel'. CosMx_Human_6K_Discovery: 7/11 present, TARGET MISSING (GUCA2A); CosMx_Human_Universal_1K: 4/11 present, TARGET MISSING (GUCA2A)
